verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an API reference exists (lookups 'live in the API reference') and a sandbox environment for testing, but nothing shows the reference is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples. A static reference and a sandbox are adjacent features, not the capability this story asks for. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe also returned 404 at every candidate path, so there is no machine-readable spec that would typically back an interactive explorer.
